snippet.title: Ascender - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Ascend from the depths of the abyss in this original 8-BIT style arcade game.
Navigate through challenging terrain and defeat enemies while trying not to overheat your engine.

Play Online on #indiexpo website: https://www.indiexpo.net/games/ascender

Developed by Peter Moyle
About indiexpo:
indiexpo allows thousands of people to discover, watch and share indie games and originally-created games. It provides an area for people to connect, inform, and inspire others across the globe and acts as a distribution platform for original content creators and advertisers large and small.

Ascender | Official Trailer | indiexpo
